distractors: High D-dimer and right-ventricular strain initially favored pulmonary embolism.
critical_safety_points: Symptomatic bradycardia and AV block need prompt stabilization and pacing assessment.
Do not diagnose PE solely from elevated D-dimer.
Anticoagulation decision with atrial standstill requires explicit individualized assessment.
